_comment_csp: script-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' because the whole UI is wired with inline onclick= attributes; removing it would break every button. Converting those to addEventListener is the follow-up that lets this be tightened — until then the real XSS defence is the escaping in js/utils.js. connect-src pins the API to the Render backend, so injected code cannot exfiltrate to an attacker's server.
